content.title: Brooklyn street closures during annual NYC Half Marathon Sunday 3/15 | Brooklyn Bridge Parents - News, Events and Family Services
content.text: More than 30,000 runners will take over the streets this Sunday for the 2026 NYC Half from Prospect Park via the Brooklyn Bridge to Times Square. While the NYC Half Marathon historically crossed the Manhattan Bridge, the route was officially changed in 2025. The runners now cross the Brooklyn Bridge instead, meaning the Manhattan Bridge remains fully open and actually serves as a primary alternate route between the boroughs during the event. Here are the street closures in Brooklyn: 12 AM (Midnight) Closures Eastern Parkway: From Grand Army Plaza to Bedford Ave (including the north service road from Underhill to Bedford and the south service road from Washington to Franklin). Reopens at 11:30 AM. Union St, President St, Carroll St, Crown St, Montgomery St, & Sullivan Pl: All blocked between Classon/Washington Ave and Franklin Ave. Reopens at 12:30 PM. Flatbush Avenue: From Grand Army Plaza to Ocean Ave/Empire Blvd, and from Grand Army Plaza to Tillary St. Reopens at 1:00 PM. Washington Avenue: From Eastern Parkway to Carroll St. Reopens at 2:00 PM. Classon Avenue: From Eastern Parkway to President St. Reopens at 3:00 PM. 4 AM Closures Empire Boulevard: From Flatbush Ave to Bedford Ave. Reopens at 10:30 AM. 5:30 AM Closures Flatbush Avenue: South side from Eastern Pkwy to Ocean Ave/Empire Blvd, and north side from Grand Army Plaza to Atlantic Ave. Reopens at 11:30 AM. Flatbush Avenue: From Atlantic Ave to Tillary St. Reopens at 11:45 AM. Park Avenue (Westbound): From Navy St to Tillary St. Reopens at 11:30 AM. Tillary Street: From Adams St/Brooklyn Bridge Blvd to Gold St, and eastbound from Cadman Plaza to Adams St. Reopens at 11:30 AM. Adams Street / Brooklyn Bridge Blvd (Northbound): From Fulton St to the Brooklyn Bridge. Reopens at 11:30 AM. Jay Street: Northbound from Willoughby St to Tillary St, and southbound from Sands St to Tillary St. Reopens at 11:30 AM. Sands Street & Jay Street (Westbound): Heading toward the Brooklyn Bridge. Reopens at 11:30 AM. Manhattan Bridge / Flatbush Ave Extension (Southbound): From Flatbush Ave to Tillary St. Reopens at 11:30 AM. Pearl Street (Southbound): From Prospect St to Sands St. Reopens at 11:30 AM. BQE Ramps: Eastbound exits at Cadman Plaza (Exit 28A), Brooklyn Bridge (Exit 28B), and Tillary St (Exit 29B); Westbound exit at Tillary St (Exit 29). Reopens at 11:30 AM. 6 AM Closures Washington Avenue: From Carroll St to Empire Blvd. Reopens at 10:30 AM. Empire Boulevard: From Washington Ave to Flatbush Ave. Reopens at 10:30 AM. Flatbush Avenue: From Empire Blvd to Grand Army Plaza. Reopens at 10:30 AM.
